rejected_candidates.reason: Explicitly documented as working regardless of task status ("No status-based ABORT rules. The skill works regardless of task status. Routing is determined by plan file existence, not status."). skill_validate_input() blocks completed/abandoned/expanded tasks with exit 1 -- migrating would remove documented, intentional behavior (revising a plan for a task in any status, including terminal ones). Left alone per the plan's per-site judgment requirement.
rejected_candidates.evidence: agent-system/extensions/core/skills/skill-reviser/SKILL.md, Stage 1 section, the line immediately following the task-lookup block

rejected_candidates.reason: Used for manual status corrections and recovery when workflow skills fail, including recovering tasks potentially stuck in unusual states, and for testing status-update behavior in isolation. Its own Stage 1 validation only checks existence (no status/task_type/project_name extraction at all), unlike the other candidates. Imposing skill_validate_input()'s terminal-state block risks blocking legitimate recovery operations this skill exists to perform. Left alone per the plan's per-site judgment requirement.
